title: Autoformer: Decomposition Transformers with Auto-Correlation for Long-Term Series Forecasting
grouping: Two large rounded black-outlined containers, 'Autoformer Encoder' on top and 'Autoformer Decoder' below, each titled at a corner with its repeat count ('N x', 'M x') in the opposite corner; one wire leaves the encoder's right end and drops into the decoder's second correlation block. Blocks are coloured by type and the colours repeat in both containers: green Auto-Correlation, light blue Series Decomp, pink Feed Forward. Inputs sit outside the containers at the left; a three-plot explanatory inset sits unframed in the top-right corner.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with no outline and pastel fills, circled plus glyphs for residual sums, thin black arrows with small K/V/Q letters on the three attention inputs. Data is drawn as real curves in small framed plots: the encoder input shows a short black series followed by an empty 'To Predict' region behind a vertical divider; 'Seasonal Init' shows an orange series fading into a faint continuation labelled 'Zero'; 'Trend-cyclical Init' a blue series with a dashed 'Input Data Mean' line. The inset stacks the raw series (black with the blue trend overlaid), its seasonal part (orange, dashed zero line) and its trend-cyclical part (blue, dashed data-mean line). The decoder has a second lower lane: a straight horizontal trend line with circled pluses that collect a down-arrow from each Series Decomp. 'Prediction' is a rotated label on a grey tab at the far right.
proposed_highlight: The two proposed blocks (Auto-Correlation, Series Decomp) are the only green and blue blocks and recur in every layer; the caption points readers to the blue blocks. The decomposition is explained by the inset of real curves rather than by text, and the trend lane is drawn as its own accumulating path under the decoder.
lesson: Explain the decomposition block with a small stacked inset of the input series, its seasonal part and its trend part drawn as real curves, and draw the trend as a separate lower lane that accumulates each decomposition block's output through circled pluses.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF footer (35th NeurIPS, 2021).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: long-term time-series forecasting with series decomposition

core.what: the decoder runs two lanes inside one container: a seasonal row of blocks on top and a trend lane along the bottom that accumulates each Series Decomp block's output through a chain of circled pluses, the two summed at the Prediction edge

relations.form: in the Autoformer Decoder, each of three blue Series Decomp blocks drops a vertical arrow into a plus on one straight horizontal trend line that starts at the Trend-cyclical Init thumbnail and runs to the right edge
each container is one left-to-right row: Auto-Correlation -> + -> Series Decomp -> (Auto-Correlation ->) Feed Forward -> + -> Series Decomp, with residual lines looping over or under each block pair

the Encoder (N x) container sits above the wider Decoder (M x) container; the encoder output leaves its right edge and drops by a right-angled line into the K, V inputs of the decoder's second Auto-Correlation

inputs are drawn as small time-series thumbnails (encoder input with a dashed 'To Predict' region, seasonal init with an orange zero tail, trend init with a blue mean line), and a three-row inset at top right shows a real series split into seasonal and trend-cyclical curves
the seasonal row's last output and the trend lane meet at one circled plus beside a grey 'Prediction' tab at the right edge

channels.colour: block fill = block type (green Auto-Correlation, blue Series Decomp, pink Feed Forward), consistent in both containers; in the curves, orange = seasonal and blue = trend - blue thus marks both the decomposition block and the trend component
channels.shape: rounded rectangles = blocks, circled plus = addition, framed line plots = series data
channels.line: solid black lines throughout; residuals drawn as right-angled loops; the trend lane is a heavier straight line
channels.frame: rounded black-outlined container = one repeated layer (N x encoder, M x decoder)

quality.strengths: the decomposition is shown, not described - a real series split into seasonal and trend curves in the inset - and the trend accumulation is a dedicated straight lane under the decoder, so the dual-stream idea is geometry; the two new block types keep one fill each across encoder and decoder
quality.weaknesses: the encoder-to-decoder connection is a long right-angled line looping from the encoder's right edge back left into the decoder; residual loops over and under each block add many bends; blue doubles as block type and trend component; the decomposition inset is not linked to any Series Decomp block

insights.structure: Two rounded containers stacked vertically: the Autoformer Encoder (N x) on top and a wider Autoformer Decoder (M x) below, each a row of Auto-Correlation, Series Decomp and Feed Forward blocks with add nodes; a decomposition example panel sits at top right.
insights.data: Inputs are small line-plot thumbnails (encoder input with a dashed 'To Predict' region, seasonal init with orange zero tail, trend-cyclical init with blue mean line), and a three-row plot at top right shows a series split into seasonal and trend parts.
insights.emphasis: Blocks are colour-coded by type (green Auto-Correlation, blue Series Decomp, pink Feed Forward), making the repeated decomposition blocks the dominant visual rhythm.
insights.flow: Left-to-right in each container; the encoder output drops by an elbow line into the decoder's second Auto-Correlation, and the decoder's trend path runs as a separate bottom line accumulating at add nodes before the final Prediction.
insights.avoid: The decomposition example panel floats in the top-right corner unconnected to any block, and the K/V/Q micro-labels on block inputs are too small to read.

arrangement.units: two horizontal rounded containers (encoder above, decoder below) holding flat coloured blocks
arrangement.inputs_as: line-plot thumbnails of the input series and initialisations
arrangement.shared: encoder output feeds decoder cross auto-correlation
